notes: Cases INT-TOTAL-01..06 and 08..13 of PV-INTEGRITY-TOTALITY-001 (accepted by PV-REV-INT-TOTALITY-001), transcribed from the contract's Required conformance cases section and adopted in 0.1.9 under rule integrity.bands.v1+ci-unit-004. A newest revision still being verified is spoken for by no older verdict: only an already-true established FAILING predicate (at least four decisive revisions, a failure ratio of at least one quarter) names a band, DEGRADED / FAILING / EXACT; every other region is UNKNOWN with no band. A positively unconfigured repository with only non-decisive recent records is UNINSTRUMENTED with CI_UNINSTRUMENTED_WITH_RECENT_NONDECISIVE_HISTORY. INT-TOTAL-07 (RAW_RUNS) and INT-TOTAL-14 (GitLab equivalence) are not materialized: this implementation has no RAW_RUNS sample path and no GitLab adapter. INT-TOTAL-13 starts at the provider-native normalization, because its subject is that a failure followed by a re-run in progress keeps its contribution whatever the enumeration order.

vectors.title: Configured CI, a newest revision still being verified and no decisive history is UNKNOWN with no band, never NO_DECISIVE_RUNS
Two decisive passes and a newest unresolved revision is UNKNOWN: an older pass does not make it SPARSE
One pass, one failure and a newest unresolved revision is UNKNOWN: neither SPARSE_MIXED nor FAILING without the established predicate
Four decisive passes and a newest unresolved revision is UNKNOWN, never CLEAN
Four passes and one failure (a ratio below one quarter) with a newest unresolved revision is UNKNOWN, never FLAKY through an inherited pass
Three passes and one failure already satisfy the established FAILING predicate: DEGRADED / FAILING / EXACT with the unresolved state explicit
Positively unconfigured CI with no decisive evidence and one recent NOT_EXECUTED record is exactly UNINSTRUMENTED, the record kept visible
The same with one recent NON_VERIFY_TERMINAL record: UNINSTRUMENTED with the diagnostic, the record kept visible
Configured CI with only recent non-decisive records stays NO_DECISIVE_RUNS: the unconfigured rule does not leak across configured=true
A newest UNKNOWN over a history that satisfies established FAILING stays UNKNOWN: PV-REV-INTEGRITY-UNKNOWN-001 is authoritative
A required revision series acquired PARTIAL is UNKNOWN with no band, whatever the unresolved or failing history it holds
A failure followed by a re-run still in progress on the same revision keeps its VERIFY_FAIL contribution, and the established FAILING projection holds in every enumeration order
